title: Special Delivery
content: Yesterday morning our shipment ofImaginative Realismarrived, and we packaged up all the orders so far. Here's a look behind the scenes at our high-tech operation.Amazon says they won't ship until October 20, so it's not too late for you U.S. customers to switch your order to theDinotopia Store. Where else can you get a signed book, plus service from a parakeet and a puppet, and our unique C.R.U.D. service (Custom Rural Unicycle Delivery)?Tomorrow: Don't miss the last installment of Video Week.
